name: Oakland International Airport

runway.v: four runways (15/33, 12/30, 10R/28L, 10L/28R); the longest size shown on the FAA diagram is 10,520 ft x 150 ft (about 3,206 m x 46 m)

customs.v: CBP arrival inspections generally 7 days a week, 08:30-15:30; CBP office weekdays 06:00-18:00 and weekends 08:00-16:00 Pacific Time; permission to land must be requested at least 24 hours before arrival; outside these hours contact Westbay Cargo

ppr.v: for international arrivals, CBP permission to land at least 24 hours in advance
ppr.quote: at least 24 hours in advance of the anticipated arrival time

hours.v: airport attended all months, all days, all hours (24 hours)
hours.quote: All Months, All Days, All Hours

noise.v: preferential runway use program 22:00-06:00 (preferred arrival 28L, departures 10R or 28R); a 24-hour noise abatement procedure applies to turbojet and turbofan aircraft (avoid departing 28L/28R or landing 10R/10L); procedures do not apply in emergencies or when runway 12/30 is closed
noise.quote: PREFERENTIAL RWY USE PROGRAM IN EFFECT 2200-0600.

curfew.v: no ban found; voluntary noise abatement programme 22:00-07:00 Monday to Saturday and 22:00-08:00 Sunday; the airport prefers jets to depart runway 30
curfew.quote: Oakland Airport has a voluntary noise abatement program from Monday-Saturday between 2200L-0700L

handling.v: two FBOs listed by the airport: KaiserAir, Inc. and Signature Aviation; Signature services are available 24 hours a day
handling.quote: Signature Aviation is a fixed-base operator with services available 24 hours a day.

notes: Runway designators and sizes are from the FAA airport diagram AL-294 (6 Aug-3 Sep 2026); the extracted text lists 6213 X 150, 10520 X 150 and 5457 X 150 without tying each to a runway, so only the longest size is recorded; metres are my conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m).
